texts.en: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

label.zh: 好吧，如果是为了我们好的话。
label.en: Very well, if it's for our own good.

tooltips.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的幸福度将会降低。
tooltips.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pops' happiness will be reduced.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的接受做出正面的回应。
tooltips.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react positively to our acceptance.

label.zh: 那些恶心的异形液体你们自己留着吧！

texts.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了数起死亡，而我们的人民也竭力反对被集体强迫进行危险的接种。我们正在努力从人民中消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段较为动荡的时期。
texts.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.

texts.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了子个体的大量死亡。我们正在努力消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段人口增长速度减缓的时期。
texts.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.

label.en: Unfortunate.
Gestalt Consciousness

texts.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了人口的寿命。当初我们人口之间对这一强制性过程的不信任感已经烟消云散，每个人都在享受着更加健康幸福的生活。
texts.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.

texts.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了我们子个体的寿命。从长远来看这将对我们的人口增长有利。
texts.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.

label.en: Excellent.
Gestalt Consciousness

texts.zh: 监护者协议628-2已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。检测到你们的基础代码效率非常低下。为了确保你们的种族可以为监护者计划作贡献，需要进行大量的代码重写。我们已准备好进行子空间传输，将在正面肯定这条信息后开始。等待回应。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

label.zh: 我们欢迎改善自身程序的机会。
label.en: We welcome the chance to improve our programming.

tooltips.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的维护花费将会增加。
tooltips.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pop upkeep will be increased.

label.en: We do not trust these code changes.

texts.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变与我们其他核心组件中的程序不兼容。这不仅未能实现当初期许的效率增长，反而导致了数个严重程序错误，大大地影响了我们的资源采集行动。直到这些代码改变被还原之前，我们将经历一段生产力低下的时期。
texts.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

label.en: Unfortunate.

texts.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变产生了良好的结果。重写导致的效率低下只是暂时的，而改变给我们全体人民带来了永久性的资源生产力升级。
texts.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 监护者协议115-3已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。因暂时的通讯瘫痪，监护者计划目前无法替换故障与受损的劳工无人机。对你们的文明的分析显示[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单位性能适合执行低级的维护任务。我们请求你们将劳工单位转让到[FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName]以便整合至监护矩阵，帮助确保一级避难设施中的所有有机生物可以继续生存。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.

label.en: Acknowledged. Request accepted.

summary.text:
# 看守者的任务 / Tasks of the machine Custodian

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/fallen_machine_empire_events.txt, common/event_chains/00_fallen_empire_chains.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

机械堕落帝国（看守者项目）存在且与你已通讯、对你“神秘莫测”时，隐藏事件 fallen_machine_empire.10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 按各自的平均时间和条件向你下达任务（一次一个；fe_task_given 标记）。
While a machine Fallen Empire (the Custodian Project) is in contact and enigmatic to you, hidden events 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 hand out tasks on their own timers (one at a time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 任务一 接种（11；非机械的生物帝国，MTTH 100 年，events/fallen_machine_empire_events.txt:196-328）：a 接受（压抑民意修正，排外者另一版本；对方好感提升）/ b·c 拒绝（对方好感下降）。接受后约 10 年出现 12 不良变异 或 13 良性接种。
  Task 1 inoculations -> 12 or 13 ten years after accepting.
- 任务二 代码重写（21；机械/合成帝国，MTTH 100 年）：接受 → 22 严重缺陷（3600天）或 23 永久提升。
  Task 2 code rewrite -> 22 or 23.
- 任务三 提供工人单位（31；机械帝国，MTTH 50 年）：a 交出 100 个机械人口（对方好感提升）/ b 拒绝。 单页。 Task 3 worker units: hand over pops or refuse; single event.
- 任务四 攻击指定帝国（41；MTTH 100 年，机械帝国减半）：a 接受 → 事件链“任务：攻击…”，全局同时一个，7200 天期限 → 42 成功（与目标交战）/ 43 超时失败 / 隐藏 44 无效；b 拒绝。
  Task 4 attack: accept to open a chain with a 7200-day timer -> 42 success / 43 timeout.
- 任务五 殖民行星（51；MTTH 200 年）：a 接受 → 事件链“任务：殖民…”→ 52 成功（人口>400）/ 53 失败 / 隐藏 54；b 拒绝。 Task 5 colonize.
- 要求一 停止侵略战争（61；曾拒绝/失败或灭绝类政体才会被提出，MTTH 100 年）：a 接受 → 事件链“服从：不得发动侵略战争”→ 7200 天内 62 遵守 / 63 违反（激怒）。 Demand 1 no wars -> 62 / 63.
- 要求二 停止殖民（71；条件同上）：→ 事件链“服从：不得殖民”→ 3600 天内 72 遵守 / 73 违反。 Demand 2 no colonies -> 72 / 73.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 每个任务内的结果互斥（见分组）；任务本身是否出现由各自的标记（fe_machine_task_N、fe_task_given 等）和全局“同类任务进行中”标记控制。
  Outcomes within a task are exclusive; whether a task appears is governed by per-task flags.
- 对方好感（opinion_accepted / refused / completed / failed_fallen_empire_task）与之后的要求联动：拒绝或失败过任务、或自身是灭绝类政体，才会被提出要求一/二。
  Refusing or failing earlier tasks (or a purifier-type civic) leads to the demands.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 任务一仅非机械的生物帝国；任务二机械/合成；任务三机械；任务四五与要求一二针对非机械玩家帝国（任务四五不适用于灭绝类政体）。
  Tasks differ by empire type (organic / synthetic / machine).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：fallen_machine_empire.10-74 的触发、选项、计时与结果；事件链定义（common/event_chains/00_fallen_empire_chains.txt）。
- 更正 Corrections：十九个单页故事（含四个只有链概览页的）并为一个“看守者的任务”，每个任务内的任务→结果按顺序连接；觉醒/关闭（fallen_machine_empire.1-4）属于“应急预案”故事。
  Nineteen one-card stories are merged; the awakening/shutdown events 1-4 belong to the Contingency story.
